The link ends if the minotaur has the incapacitated condition or uses this ability on a different target.

monsters.name: Oddlewin
monsters.description: Oddlewin from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Fortune Teller
traits.description: Oddlewin can cast the Augury spell as a ritual, using cards as the material component.

traits.name: Nilbogism
traits.description: Any creature that attempts to damage Oddlewin must first succeed on a 12 Charisma saving throw or have the charmed condition until the end of the creature's next turn. The creature must use its action praising Oddlewin. Oddlewin can't regain hit points, including through magical healing, except through his Reversal of Fortune reaction.

actions.name: Fool's Scepter
actions.description: mw 4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Cloud of Cards
actions.description: Oddlewin conjures magical cards that slash at the air in a 5-foot cube within 60 feet of Oddlewin until the start of Oddlewin's next turn. A creature that starts its turn in the cube or that enters that area for the first time on a turn takes 10 (4d4) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: Oddlewin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Reversal of Fortune
reactions.description: In response to another creature dealing damage to Oddlewin, Oddlewin reduces the damage to 0 and regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

monsters.name: Otherworldly Corrupter
monsters.description: Otherworldly Corrupter from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.description: Magic and other features can't determine the corrupter's creature type. If a creature tries to read the corrupter's thoughts, that creature must succeed on a 20 Intelligence saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the corrupter fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The corrupter can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The corrupter makes three Whispering Blade attacks and can use Debilitating Touch.

actions.name: Whispering Blade
actions.description: mw,rw 12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 20 Wisdom saving throw or be unable to speak until the start of the corrupter's next turn.

actions.name: Debilitating Touch
actions.description: The corrupter's squirming tentacle lashes out at a creature the corrupter can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 20 Constitution saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn, after which the target is immune to this Debilitating Touch for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The corrupter magically transforms into any creature that is Small or Medium, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the corrupter is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: When an attacker the corrupter can see hits the corrupter with an attack, the corrupter halves the attack's damage against it.

legendaryActions.name: Cunning
legendaryActions.description: The corrupter escapes nonmagical restraints and ends the grappled and restrained conditions on itself, then moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Stab (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The corrupter makes one Whispering Blade attack.

legendaryActions.name: Amorphous Escape (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The corrupter dissolves into a shifting mass of flesh, tentacles, eyes, claws, and mouths. Up to two creatures the corrupter can see within 20 feet of itself must make a 20 Intelligence saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This transformation lasts until the end of the corrupter's next turn. While transformed, the corrupter has advantage on attack rolls, attack rolls made against it have disadvantage, and it can move through spaces at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

monsters.name: Pazrodine
monsters.description: Pazrodine from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Guardian of the Market
traits.description: Pazrodine can sense when an item is stolen from Seelie Market. She knows the distance and direction to stolen items, as if by the Locate Object spell.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Pazrodine fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Pazrodine makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: mw 13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 21 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Breath Weapon 5
actions.description: Pazrodine uses one of the following breath weapons: Dream Breath: Pazrodine exhales mist in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a 21 Constitution saving throw or have the unconscious condition for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it. Moonlight Breath: Pazrodine exhales a beam of moonlight in a 120-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 60 (11d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.name: Tail
legendaryActions.description: Pazrodine makes one Tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: Pazrodine uses Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Quadrone Detention Drone
monsters.description: Quadrone Detention Drone from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Axiomatic Mind
traits.description: The drone can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its instructions.

traits.name: Disintegration
traits.description: If the drone dies, its body disintegrates into dust, leaving behind its weapons and anything else it was carrying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The drone makes two fist attacks or four shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: mw 3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: rw 4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Detention Orb
actions.description: The drone launches a tiny orb of magical force at a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The creature must succeed on a 15 Constitution saving throw or be encased in the orb, which expands to a size just large enough to contain the creature. While encased, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Nothing can pass through the orb, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to enter or exit the orb. As a bonus action, the drone can move the orb and its contents up to 30 feet in any direction. A successful casting of the Dispel Magic spell on the orb (15) destroys it. The orb otherwise remains intact until the drone spends an action to end the effect or the drone is destroyed. A drone can have only one detention orb active at a time; if the drone creates a detention orb when it already has one active, the first orb disappears, freeing the creature inside.

monsters.name: Reaper Spirit
monsters.description: Reaper Spirit from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The spirit can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet shunted.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the level of the spell (rounded down).

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.description: mw your spell attack modifier to hit (with advantage), reach 5 ft., the creature haunted by Haunt Creature. {@h}1d8 + 3 + summonSpellLevel necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Haunt Creature
bonusActions.description: The spirit targets a creature it can see within 10 feet of itself and begins haunting it. While the target is haunted, you and the spirit sense the direction and distance to the target if it is on the same plane of existence as you. Additionally, if the target starts its turn within 10 feet of the spirit, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the frightened condition until the start of the target's next turn. The target remains haunted until it dies, the spirit disappears, or the spirit uses this action again.

monsters.name: Riffler
monsters.description: Riffler from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Card Sense
traits.description: The riffler can smell the presence of magical cards, including Decks of Many Things and other magical decks, within 1 mile of itself. It knows the direction to any such cards in that range. Effects that protect a target from divination magic block this sense.

traits.name: Riffling Step
traits.description: The riffler can burrow through any nonmagical material that isn't iron, shuffling the substance through which the riffler moves aside like cards to form a tunnel that closes behind the riffler.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The riffler makes two Spectral Card attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Card
actions.description: ms,rs 6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d10 + 3) force damage plus 5 (1d10) damage that is radiant if the d10 roll is an even number and necrotic if it's odd.

actions.name: Card Spray 5
actions.description: The riffler magically unleashes a spray of spectral cards in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (5d10) force damage and has the restrained condition for 1 minute as cards bind it. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A restrained creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Plane Shift
actions.description: The riffler casts the Plane Shift spell targeting only itself, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

reactions.name: Shuffle Destiny
reactions.description: When a creature the riffler can see within 30 feet of itself makes an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw, the riffler can magically force that creature to roll a d6 and either add the number rolled to the total or subtract it from the total (riffler's choice), potentially changing the outcome.

monsters.name: Ruin Spider
monsters.description: Ruin Spider from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Ruinous Acid
traits.description: Any nonmagical weapon that hits the spider corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the spider is destroyed after dealing damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.description: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spider makes two Ruinous Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Web.

actions.name: Ruinous Bite
actions.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage and 9 (2d8) acid damage. In addition, if the target is a creature wearing nonmagical armor, the armor takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an Armor Class of 10 is destroyed.

actions.name: Web 5
actions.description: rw 7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}The target has the restrained condition. As an action, a restrained target can make a 13 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a successful check. The webbing can also be destroyed (AC 10; 5 hit points; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to acid, bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

monsters.name: Sir Jared
monsters.description: Sir Jared from The Book of Many Things.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Jared makes three Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: mw 7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage. On a roll of 19 or 20, Jared scores a critical hit.

reactions.name: Protect Ally
reactions.description: When a creature Jared can see attacks a target other than Jared that is within 5 feet of him, Jared imposes disadvantage on the attack roll.

monsters.name: Solar Bastion Knight
monsters.description: Solar Bastion Knight from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.description: The knight and each ally within 10 feet of it have advantage on saving throws. This trait is suppressed while the knight has the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The knight makes three Sunspear attacks.

actions.name: Sunspear
actions.description: ms,rs 8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 (3d6 + 4) radiant damage, or 21 (5d6 + 4) radiant damage if the target is a Fiend or an Undead.

actions.name: Solar Flare 5
actions.description: The knight unleashes a blaze of brilliant energy that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the knight. Each creature of the knight's choice in that area must make a 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 (4d10) radiant damage and has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. For the next minute, the affected area is filled with bright light that is sunlight.

monsters.name: Talon Beast
monsters.description: Talon Beast from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The talon beast has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.description: The talon beast can detect and pinpoint the location of magic within 120 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The talon beast makes two Talon attacks or a Talon attack and a Beak attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage, and if the target has any spell effects on itself or any magic items in its possession, the target must make a 15 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a random spell effect on the target ends. If the target has no spell effects on it, one random magic item in its possession has its magical properties suppressed for 1 minute. If the item is a potion or scroll, it becomes nonmagical instead.

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: mw 9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage, and the target has the grappled condition (escape 17). Until the grapple ends, the target has the restrained condition, and the talon beast can't use Talon on another target.

monsters.name: Veiled Presence
monsters.description: Veiled Presence from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Inviolate Presence
traits.description: The veiled presence can't be targeted by divination magic or by features that would read its mind or determine its creature type.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the veiled presence fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The veiled presence makes two Blade of Judgment attacks and can use Revelation.

actions.name: Blade of Judgment
actions.description: mw,rw 14 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 (1d6 + 7) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a 22 Charisma saving throw, or on its next turn, it can either move or take an action, but not both.

actions.name: Revelation
actions.description: The veiled presence reveals a glimpse of its otherworldly nature to a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a 22 Wisdom saving throw or have the paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn, after which the target is immune to this Revelation for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.description: When an attacker the veiled presence can see hits the veiled presence with an attack, the veiled presence halves the attack's damage against it.

legendaryActions.name: Flash Step
legendaryActions.description: The veiled presence magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see.

legendaryActions.name: Stab (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The veiled presence makes one Blade of Judgment attack.

legendaryActions.name: Searing Radiance (Costs 3 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The veiled presence magically emanates dazzling light in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on itself until the end of its next turn, during which time attack rolls against it have disadvantage and it has advantage on attack rolls. The sphere moves with the veiled presence. When another creature starts its turn in the light or enters the light for the first time on its turn, that creature must make a 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Werevulture
monsters.description: Werevulture from The Book of Many Things.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The werevulture regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the werevulture takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the werevulture's next turn. The werevulture dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The werevulture makes two Talon attacks, or it makes a Beak attack and a Talon attack.

actions.name: Beak (Vulture or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it must succeed on a 13 Constitution saving throw or be cursed until targeted by the Remove Curse spell or a similar effect. If the cursed target drops to 0 hit points, it becomes a werevulture under the DM's control and regains 10 hit points.

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: mw 5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (4d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: rw 4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Change Shape
bonusActions.description: The werevulture polymorphs into a vulture-humanoid hybrid, into a vulture, or back into its humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its humanoid form if it dies.
